title: Announcing PROJECT: CITY LIFE
excerpt: Our new game is a free open-world game set in San Cordova, a fictional coastal city inspired by Miami, built from scratch in Unreal Engine 5.8.
body:
MOONCREST GROUP is working on a new game: **PROJECT: CITY LIFE**.

City Life is an open-world game set in **San Cordova**, a fictional coastal city inspired by Miami and South Florida. The city should feel recognisable, but it is designed freely, with its own streets and buildings.

- Built from scratch in **Unreal Engine 5.8**
- Planned to be **free to play**
- In early development

Gameplay, platforms and the release window will be announced later. Development updates will appear on the [City Life page](/projects/city-life/).
